summary: The response (Statement O, item 6) states that increased traffic volumes will result from growth in air passenger traffic to Mitchell Field, not merely from construction of the Airport Spur.
text: 6. The increase in traffic volumes will result because of the increase in air passenger traffic to Mitchell Field and not just because the Airport Spur is constructed.
